snippet.title: Momo Don't Leave - VAINSANE Fridays #5
snippet.description:
VAINSANE Fridays #5 — Momo Don't Leave

Return to a town that never changed… and a friend who's supposed to be dead. A psychological horror visual novel about memory and the cost of refusing to move forward.

Part of VAINSANE Fridays, where I release a new bite-sized horror game every other Friday. Releasing May, 2026.

Wishlist/Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4630050/Momo_Dont_Leave/
